name: Merritt Reservoir SRA - Willow Cove Campground
Calamus Reservoir SRA - Valley View Flat Campground
Swanson Reservoir SRA - Lake View loop
why: Not a separate place: ReserveAmerica park 234151 loop LAKE VIEW (read 2026-11-05) puts its 8 sites (045-052, GIS centroid 40.15086,-101.06823) 0.48 km from the nearest Spring Canyon site (042) and 0.72 km from Spring Canyon's site centroid, on a short spur off the same SRA access road that serves Spring Canyon (Esri World Imagery, rendered 2026-11-05) - under the ~1 km / own-entrance bar, so it is covered by 2741 Swanson Reservoir SRA - Spring Canyon Campground (whose pin is only 0.43 km away).

name: Miller Creek - Lewis and Clark SRA
Willow Springs RV Park & Campground
why: Private park with no operator website, no booking page and no RV Life listing: only directory records (AAA 'call for rates', The Dyrt unclaimed/not bookable, 1 review 2025-05, priceLow $0), and Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-05) shows 4.2 from 12 reviews, phone 308-750-1364, no website - under the 25-review floor, so neither the price nor the presence indicator is met (curation doc private rule, AWH 2026-10-14). MHVillage lists the same address (46854 Willow Springs Rd) as 'Willow Springs Mobile Home Park', and Esri imagery at 41.7814,-99.0985 (300 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-05) shows a small tree-shaded cluster of parked trailers/RVs and mobile homes - a likely long-stay park as well.

name: Calamus Lodge Campground (now Calamus Motel & RV)
kind_of_no: long-stay park (nights not really for sale)
why: Mostly annual-lease park failing long-stay test 2 and with no price indicator: the operator's last readable page (calamuslodge.com/campground.php, Wayback 2026-05-08) says '25 long-term shaded camp sites ... only rented annually' (status FULL, 'call to join the waiting list'), plus '6 short-term campsites which have a 2-night minimum stay' with water and electric, status not shown, 'Please call for price' - no posted nightly rate, no booking site, no RV Life listing (Algolia park index, 2026-11-05) and not in the Good Sam directory. calamuslodge.com now redirects to an unrelated apartments site (commercialsquareapartments.com, 2026-11-05); Google Maps names the business Calamus Motel & RV, LLC (4.6 from 57 reviews, 308-346-4331) with a new site calamusmotelandrv.com that refused every automated read (Cloudflare 403 / 'Too Many Requests', 2026-11-05). On the fence + mostly seasonal + iffy = drop (AWH 2026-10-31).

name: Dad's Calamus East
why: Private: a fuel station / convenience store (Dad's Calamus East, 220 N 13th Ave) with seven full-hookup camper sites on the east side of its lot (land.com / LoopNet / AcreValue sale listings, read 2026-11-05) - no operator website, no booking page, no RV Life or Good Sam listing, no posted rate; Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-05) 4.1 from 16 reviews, phone 308-346-5567, no website - under the 25-review floor, so neither the price nor the presence indicator is met (curation doc private rule, AWH 2026-10-14). The only listing that names it as camping is the City of Burwell camping page (name + phone only).

name: Clyde City Park
why: No source confirms designated RV sites or current overnight camping, checked 2026-11-05. (1) City of Clyde site (clydekansas.org, Community Services page in the Wayback captures of 2016-02, 2024-03 and 2026-05; the live domain refuses connections) describes only 'two parks with playground equipment', a pool, ball field, tennis, pickleball and basketball, and never mentions camping. (2) Cloud County Tourism's Stay page lists Rock Island RV Park as Clyde's only RV option and omits the city park. (3) Google Maps 'Clyde City Park' (196 Perrier St, 39.59485,-97.40408) is a 'Park' with no phone, 4.4 from 11 reviews; the 5 visible (1-5 yrs) are about the playground, basketball court, bathrooms and the demolition derby, none about camping, and the limited view hid the other 6. (4) The only camping claims are aggregators repeating Ultimate Campgrounds data from 'November 2016' (CampgroundTour: '2 sites', '6 electric', $0, no toilets; AllStays: '6 sites ... Tents'), which contradict each other. RV Life does not list it. Esri imagery (2026-11-05, 160 m frame) shows an ordinary town park with no visible RV pads or pedestals.

name: Tuttle Creek State Park - South Randolph Area
Webster State Park (Lake View)
why: Part of 2087 Webster State Park (stays in it): Lake View's 10 water/electric sites (068-077, campitks loop 510317, read 2026-11-06) have no entrance of their own from a public road. Their short spur leaves the unnamed paved park drive (OSM way 13224958) that runs ~2.2 km along the north shore between the 9 Road corner, where the west cluster is entered, and the end of 10 Road at the park's east entry (Esri imagery + OSM, 2026-11-06). The loop is mid-drive, 0.97 km from Hill Top's nearest pad and 1.08 km from Rock Point's, inside KDWP's single 'Oldtown Area'. 2087's note and site counts already include it.

name: Simple Stay RV Park
why: No live web presence (checked 2026-11-06): simplestayrvpark.com (and www., http, any path) 301-redirects to facebook.com/simplestayrvpark (Facebook is not a website); no booking page found on any engine; the Google Maps place at 614 Peace St (38.52921,-99.30815, phone 785-222-4107) shows no rating at all, so 0 reviews against the 25+ needed (the same gm.py run read Danny Elliott Park's 4.4/23 fine). It has a price indicator (RV Life 270180: $ tier, unrated, 16 sites), but the private rule needs both price and presence.

name: Lodder Up & Camp - Thomas Hill
why: Private park RV Life doesn't list (Algolia park index, query 'Lodder' + 6 km radius, 2026-11-07: only the Marceline park 260021) and not in the Good Sam directory (trip_data/goodsam_parks.json, 2026-11-07), so it needs the fallback quality signal (curation doc: Google/Campspot/Campendium/Dyrt >= 4.0 over ~25 reviews, or Good Sam >= 8.5); Google shows 5.0 from only 2 reviews (allcampsandparks Google mirror, 2026-11-07; the p3-314 verifier saw 5.0/10) - under the 25-review floor. Price and presence indicators pass (operator page lodderupandcamp.com/copy-of-marceline posts $35/night, contact page phone 660-815-1583, ParkWithUs booking page), and the Marceline sibling's 5*/$$ (23 reviews) belongs to a different property. Opened May 2024 and pitched partly to Thomas Hill Power Plant spring/fall outage crews.

name: Overnight Campground
why: Town of St. Paul news post 'Campgrounds Now Open!' (May 23 2025, archived 2025-10-07; the live URL now 404s): 'Reservations for the Overnight Campground are available by phone request only, as this site is not open daily. It is primarily available during weekend community events such as recreational tournaments and Rodeo Week.' Its Campspot park record (overnightcamp, id 4933, read 2026-11-10) says 'PARK IS OPEN BASED ON EVENTS AND SCHEDULING', and the availability API answered 'Park is closed for your dates' on every 2026 summer night probed (Jun 9, Jul 14, Jul 25, Jul 31, Aug 11, Sep 15), while Iron Horse's record on the same API showed free sites on Jul 14. The town's campgrounds pages (read 2026-11-10 in a headless browser) still list it with a May 15 - Sep 23 season, 24 powered / 16 unpowered sites at C$34 / C$24 and phone 780-614-4244, but say nothing about walk-up nights. It is a different place from 9066: 4800 55 Street, behind the RCMP detachment (Google: 4806 55 St, 53.9907,-111.3106) on the west end of town, about 2.7 km W of 9066's pin; Esri 2022 and 2024 imagery show a small gravel loop of grass sites with a central building at about 53.9897,-111.3108, with no rigs in either August capture. Google Maps has no listing of its own: every Overnight Campground query resolved to St. Paul Iron Horse Campground (4012 53 Ave, 53.99598,-111.26979, 4.4 on 47 reviews).

name: Shell City Landing Campground - Huntersville State Forest
Cross Ranch State Park - Governors Centennial Loop
Stump Lake Park Campground
why: Operator campground map posted on Nelson County's Stump Lake page (Stump_Lake_Park_Campground_Map-2013_Web.jpg, read 2026-11-12) numbers sites 1-131 in six sections. Only 'Cottonwood Corner Campsites (Temporary)' is marked for non-seasonal use: sites 77-79 and 94-100 (10) plus 3 primitive sites. That is 10 of 131 (7.6%), or 13 of 134 counting the primitive sites (9.7%), so under 10%. Park Rules (nelsonco.org Park Rules.docx, read 2026-11-12) put lessees on 'permanent camper sites' with sheds, decks and gazebos, and new lessees come off a waiting list. RV Life lists 10 sites; a 2015 RV Life reviewer: '95% are seasonal'.

Lake Tschida - Southside, Hawabesi & Gilligan's Hilltop (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Koehlers Point Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Schatz's Point Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Sled Creek Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Gilligan's Hilltop (Grant County)

name: Lake Tschida - Hidden Shelter Horse Campground (Grant County)
why: laketschida.org/hidden-shelter-horse-camp (read 2026-11-12): 'hidden shelter horse campground - primitive group camping', four sites booked together at $56 with four 12'x12' horse pens; 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses'.

name: KCDC Campground
why: 2026-11-12: the only sources are the City of Kulm campground page (kulmnd.com/kulm-campgrounds.html: 'KCDC Campground: 701-647-2878', phone only) and the ND HHS licensed RV park list 07.17.2025 row 197 (KCDC PARK, 6 Main Ave N, owner KULM COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CORP., 7 lots, inspected 4/24/2025). The licence address is the Kulm Clinic building downtown (Google Maps 'Kulm Clinic South Central Health', 6 Main Ave N, 46.30302,-98.94865), and neither Esri 2021-05-24 nor NAIP 2023-06-18 imagery shows RV lots there or anywhere else in town that is not the city campground or Pesek's lot. No Google Maps place, no OSM feature, no rate, hookups, season or site description anywhere; the phone is listed for Kulm Hardware (3 Main Ave N). Location, fee model, rig fit and current operation cannot be confirmed, so no pin can be placed without guessing.

name: Pesek Campground
kind_of_no: no web presence (private; no price or presence indicator)
why: 2026-11-12: the City of Kulm page (kulmnd.com/kulm-campgrounds.html) gives only 'Pesek Campground: 701-320-3799'. OSM way 874194294 (edited 2026-04-24) maps it as a ~35 x 35 m sand lot at 46.29768,-98.94912, operator Ben Pesek, fee=yes, reservation recommended, no showers, static_caravans=yes. No website, no posted rate, no booking engine, no RV Life listing, and no Google Maps place (gm.py on 'Pesek Campground Kulm ND' and 'Camp Kulm Kulm ND' both resolve to the city's Kulm Campground, 3.6/8). A private park needs a price indicator AND a presence indicator; it has neither. Nightly vs long-term share, hookups and rig fit are also unknowable from any source.

name: Kulm-Edgeley Dam (Kulm Dam WMA)
kind_of_no: wma allowance, no designated campground found
why: 2026-11-12: no operator names a campground at Kulm-Edgeley Dam. The camping right there is ND Game and Fish's general WMA allowance on the 38-acre Kulm Dam WMA ('Most WMAs are ideal for ... primitive camping', 10-day limit; gf.nd.gov/wma and /wma-listing, August 2026), not a designated campground. Not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025). Not on Google Maps (a search for the campground lands on 13574 Edgeley Campground), The Dyrt, Campendium or RV Life. The G&F 2022 contour map and its facility layer show only a ramp, a dock and a vault toilet (Kulm Rod & Gun Club), a G&F rock pier and the dam, with no camping symbol. Imagery shows a mown lawn in a shelterbelt south of the lake with picnic structures, but no pads, pedestals or RVs. The only 'campground' trace is the ndtourism title, which is never a source; MapQuest and countyoffice list 'Kulm Edgeley Dam Campground' at a Kulm street address marked CLOSED.

name: Clemens Family Campground
why: 2026-11-12: 'Clemens Family Campground' is a directory name for the Noonan Lions Club campground, not a separate private park. Google Maps resolves the name to the Lions campground place (48.8860077,-103.0063517, 505 Main St, 3.5 on 2 reviews, 47 m from 6004's pin); the ndtourism listing's pin (48.886477,-103.005819, seen as a search snippet only, ndtourism never read) is 90 m from 6004; wheretostayamerica.com (undated, (c) 2024) says it is 'Operated and maintained by the Noonan Lions Club'. No other trace: no operator site, no own Google listing, not on RV Life, not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025; Divide County's only Noonan row is NOONAN LIONS RV PARK, 7 lots).

name: North Gold RV Park
why: Google Maps (read 2026-11-12) marks North Gold RV Park, 9551 103rd St NW, Columbus, 'Permanently closed', with no website, 3 reviews from 7-8 years ago (one: 'No such place. Bogus empty lot'), and posting turned off. It is on neither RV Life nor Good Sam (Algolia indexes, 2026-11-12). The only other traces are an expired 2013 RVParkStore for-sale listing (20 full-hookup lots, built 2013 for the Bakken oil boom, 'average lot rent $650', which reads as monthly) and an unreviewed The Dyrt stub pinned 68 km away. So it has neither a price indicator nor a presence indicator, and a satellite look at Google's pin (Esri, 2026-11-12) shows a shop yard and a farmstead with no laid-out RV pads. The HHS listing alone does not make a live campground.

name: Golden Lake Acres
why: 2026-11-12: Golden Lake Acres (13648 11 St NE, Hatton; ND HHS 07.17.2025: GOLDEN LAKE ACRES, owner Dickson, Jacob, 48 units) is a private resort (bar/restaurant, store, beach) with RV spaces, but it has no website (Google lists only facebook.com/goldenlakeacres, which shows nothing without a login), no posted rate anywhere, no booking site, and is on neither RV Life (Algolia park index, nothing within 40 km but city parks) nor Good Sam (directory cache 2026-10-02, nothing within ~30 km). Presence passes (Google: RV park, 4.5 on 160 reviews, 701-963-3011, reviews mostly about the bar and burgers), but the private-park price indicator fails, and as a likely seasonal park it also fails long-stay test 2 (no nightly rate on its own website and no booking site). Steele County's Attractions page (undated) says only 'RV spaces with electricity and sewer, along with space for tents' and 'Come check out the new RV campground!' with no price.

name: Golden Lake Shores
kind_of_no: seasonal park with a wait list; no price or presence
why: 2026-11-12: Golden Lake Shores (ND HHS 07.17.2025: GOLDEN LAKE SHORES LLC, owners Williams, 30 units, 13652 11th St NE, Hatton) is a seasonal lake park. Its sale listing (Crary Real Estate MLS 24-1125, begun 2024-07-03, sold 2025-04-18, read 2026-11-12) sells 30 water/sewer/electric campsites plus the owner's house as a 'turn-key campground' that 'remains fully reserved with a wait list since it opened in 1999', with lease rate status 100%. That fails long-stay test 2 (nights must be for sale with no waitlist), and nothing shows the new owners selling nights since April 2025. It has no website, booking site or posted rate anywhere. Google Maps has no place under this name (searches return the neighbouring Golden Lake Acres and Golden Lake Tenting). It is on neither RV Life (Algolia park index, 40 km around: only Willowood, Cooperstown, Northwood and Hatton city parks) nor Good Sam (directory cache 2026-10-02, nothing within 40 km). So both the private-park price indicator and the presence indicator fail too.

name: Picnic Point Campground
why: USFS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/chequamegon-nicolet/recreation/picnic-point-recreation-area ('Picnic Point is a tent-only campground'; 'No. of Sites: 4'; whole campground reservable as one group site) and recreation.gov facility 233765 (single site GT1, 'GROUP TENT ONLY AREA NONELECTRIC', permitted equipment Tent only), both read 2026-11-17. The lead's other candidate, Spearhead Point, is already entry 3358; a recreation.gov search for 'mondeaux' returns only West Point (3360), Eastwood (3359), Spearhead Point (3358), Picnic Point and the Spearhead Point Shelter (day-use), so there is no other campground on the flowage to add.

name: City Park Campground (Oconto City Park)
why: City of Oconto 'City Park Campground Rules' PDF, linked from cityofoconto.com/camping/ (read 2026-11-17): '11. Capacity: 2 tents per site or 1 pop up camper and 1 tent.' The city admits nothing larger than a pop-up, so a 23-ft motorhome is excluded by an explicit agency rule.

name: James N. McNally Campground West (McNally West)
why: McNally West is the village's expansion of 3494 James N. McNally Campground, not a separate place. The board named it 'James N. McNally Campground West' (Burnett County Sentinel, via search snippet), and the Nov 2024 coverage of the approved expansion describes 30 added sites, 7-8 RV-ready, a $20k shower building and asphalt looping (moderncampground.com 2024-11-29). Esri imagery (read 2026-11-17) shows the new loop under construction at about 45.7782,-92.6945, with its own paved entrance off W Olson Dr. Its sites are only about 225 m west of 3494's west loop and 460 m from 3494's pin, well under the 1 km split threshold. Google Maps (read 2026-11-17) has no separate place: searches for 'McNally West' return 3494's listing, titled 'James McNally Main Campground', 4.4/22, 715-463-2405.

name: Hawthorne Hills County Park
why: Camping at Hawthorne Hills is planned, not built (read 2026-11-17). Its park page (ozaukeecounty.gov/720/Hawthorne-Hills-Park) offers only trails, river/pond fishing and grills, and the Waubedonia page (/670) still calls Waubedonia 'the only Ozaukee County Park that offers camping'. The Hawthorne Hills Master Map 2026 is a DRAFT dated 3/19/2026, and its inset campground loop is keyed 'Future Tent Campsite' / 'Future RV Campsite'. Ozaukee Press of 2026-04-29 says the bathrooms are only at design stage (Kueny Architects contract, $43,166) and 'Plans call for installing 32 campsites, most of them suitable for recreational vehicles'. No opening date is published anywhere found, so the March 2026 fee-table rates ($22 basic / $30 water-electric) are set ahead of construction.

name: Landing View Private Campground
why: Seasonal-lease campground with no nightly sales and no web presence (read 2026-11-19): Gov. of Saskatchewan release 2015-10-20 (saskatchewan.ca .../2015/october/20/sask-landing-investment) calls the park's private campgrounds 'long-term, full-service, seasonal' with 'the ability to remain in the same site, year over year' and says the first such development 'opened 80 full-service campsites in 2010 and is fully occupied' - by elimination Landing View (the park's other private businesses are Cactus Blume, 2016, and Glamping Resorts' canvas cabins); a 2026-04-26 park review (acrockofschmidt.com) calls Landing View 'this seasonal campground' and 'I can't find any information about this seasonal campground online'; no operator website, booking page, Tourism Saskatchewan listing or Google Maps place found (Google returns only the provincial park for the name); Esri imagery at 50.6640,-107.9660 shows a dense treed RV grid of parked units west of Hwy 4 by the golf course. Fails long-stay test 2 (no nightly rate or booking site) and the private presence rule.

name: Cactus Blume Campground
why: Long-term seasonal campground that sells no nights (read 2026-11-19): Tourism Saskatchewan listing 2790 (tourismsaskatchewan.com/listings/2790/cactus-blume-campground, search snippet; the page itself now returns 'No data found') calls it 'a long-term seasonal campground with 166 established full-service sites', privately operated, open mid-May to mid-Oct, contact by phone/Gmail only; Gov. of Saskatchewan release 2015-10-20 (saskatchewan.ca .../2015/october/20/sask-landing-investment) announced Cactus Blume Campground Ltd.'s 'long-term, full-service, seasonal campground' with 'the ability to remain in the same site, year over year'; a 2026-04-26 park review (acrockofschmidt.com/2026/04/26/saskatchewan-landing-provincial-park-review/) gives '166 seasonal campsites' and 'No idea how you'd learn more about getting a seasonal site here'. No operator website, booking engine or posted nightly rate found; the park's Campspot listing (sk-landing) is Glamping Resorts' canvas tents, not this campground. Fails long-stay test 2 (no nights for sale) and test 4 (0 of 166 sites nightly).

name: Big River Regional Park, Cowan Lake Campground
Hudson Bay Regional Park, Ruby Lake Recreation Site
Bronson Forest Recreation Site - Peck Lake Campground
Anglers Trail Resort
why: Private fishing resort with RV camping but no camping price anywhere: its own site (anglerstrailresort.net /accomodations, read 2026-11-19) says only 'Our camping sites offer power and water availability, along with a central shower house' with no rate, site count or booking engine; Tourism Saskatchewan listing 636 and the fishhunt/canadianlodges listings say 'campsites' / 'Contact Lodge'; RV Life has no record (Algolia park index, query + 55.0-55.35N box, 2026-11-19). Presence would pass (website + phone 306-288-2122; Google 'Angler's Trail Resort' 4.1, 83 reviews, open, at 55.1717,-107.5050) but the private rule needs a price indicator too. Home page headed 'Fishing Resort For Sale - Northern Saskatchewan' (still says open year-round).

name: Dore Lake Fish'n Camp RV Park
The Ridge on Amisk Resort
why: The lodge west of Hwy 167 on Sawmill Bay is The Ridge on Amisk Resort (formerly Rocky View Lodge, 54.68401,-102.07876): Tourism Saskatchewan listing 2724 (search snippet read 2026-11-19) says 'Accommodation choices include ten hotel rooms, three cabins and a 5th wheel trailer', rooms from $175/night, cabins from $199/night - the trailer is a rental unit, no RV sites are sold; no source (Wanderlog/Google 4.6 (94), listed temporarily closed) mentions RV sites or hookups; its own site theridgeonamisk.ca fails (self-signed certificate on https, connection reset on http). The RV camping on Sawmill Bay is the existing entry 9157 (Amisk Lake Recreation Site - Sawmill Bay Campground) east of the highway.

name: Enchanted Harbour (Enchanted Harbor Marina)
why: Identified as Enchanted Harbour (Google: 'Enchanted Harbor Marina', place point 53.755477,-105.2868332, on the causeway pin's marina basin; Resort Village of Candle Lake business directory: 'Enchanted Harbour ... #60 Hwy 265 ... RV Park & Marina', 306-514-0114). The village's RV-parks page (candlelake.ca/p/rv-parks-, read 2026-11-19) lists it among the 'Seasonal RV Parks'; Candle Lake Marketplace posts (Google snippets, read 2026-11-19) sell trailers 'on rented seasonal lot at Enchanted Harbour Marina Candle Lake Sk lot 16' and '5th wheel trailer on leased [lot] at Candle Lake - Enchanted Harbour Marina', and 'A lot at Site 31, Enchanted Harbour Marina ... for sale for $23,000. It includes a trailer' (2026-04-29). No website, no posted nightly rate, no booking engine; Google 4.8 (5) with no phone. Fails test 2 (no nightly sales) and has no price or presence indicator.

name: Buffalo Bill State Park (Lake Shore Campground)
City Slickers RV Park
why: Google Maps 'City Slickers Rv Park' (1234 Main St, Torrington; 42.05753,-104.18536, phone 307-575-1640) rates 3.8 on 42 reviews, read 2026-11-20 via gm.py: under 4.0 with 25+ reviews is a drop (AWH 2026-11-02). Supporting: RV Life 2 stars/$ on 5 reviews (unclaimed, no website; July 2025 stay rated 2: 'Sleazy full-timers right next to us'; Sept 2023: 'a fair amount of long termers'); self-service unstaffed gravel lot.

name: BJ's Campground (Highway 20 location)
kind_of_no: not separately bookable (contact-only annex of 6534, ~0.7 km away)
why: bjscampground.com home page (read 2026-11-20): 'In addition to our main campground, we offer RV-only full hookup sites at our Highway 20 location (4075 US Hwy 20, Lusk, WY) ... Please, contact us for more information' - no site count, no rate, not in the ResNexus BOOK NOW links (roomClass 10/3 = the main park's RV/tent classes; ResNexus not opened); no Google Maps business of its own (the address resolves to a bare '4075 US-20' pin at 42.75494,-104.45689, no phone/reviews); Hipcamp 'BJ's Campground' (read 2026-11-20) lists only the main park's 18 RV + 3 tent sites; Esri imagery shows a small gravel corner lot on US-20 opposite the Niobrara County Fairgrounds with a few parked rigs, ~0.7 km west of 6534's pin (under the ~1 km split threshold). No price or presence indicator of its own, so it cannot stand as a separate entry; 6534's note already mentions it.

name: Seminoe State Park (South Red Hills Campground)

Casper Mountain County Park - Elkhorn Springs Campground

Glendo State Park (Broken Arrow Campground)
why: Wyoming State Parks' own Broken Arrow page (wyoparks.wyo.gov/index.php/about-our-campgrounds/1685-broken-arrow-glendo, read as search-result text 2026-11-20; the site itself refuses with an F5 challenge) says the access road past the Indian Point Ramp 'is a dirt road, with several sandy areas' and 'Heavy precipitation can quickly make the road impassable, or at least difficult terrain, and as a result, we recommend camping at Broken Arrow only with smaller camping units and 4wheel drive vehicles'; Campflare (FacilityId 333 page, read 2026-11-20) repeats it: 'The park recommends smaller units and four-wheel-drive vehicles for this campground.' A standing agency 4WD recommendation (not limited to wet weather) on the only way in = skip (user_ekko_no_4wd).

name: Glendo State Park (Soldier Rock Campground)
why: Wyoming State Parks' own Soldier Rock page (wyoparks.wyo.gov/index.php/about-our-campgrounds/1709-soldier-rock-glendo, read as search-result text 2026-11-20; the site itself refuses with an F5 challenge): 'Four wheel drive is recommended for anyone planning to camp in Soldier Rock.' and 'Access roads to each section are narrow and poorly developed, which makes this campground suitable for smaller camping units and tents.' Campflare's copy (FacilityId 346 page, read 2026-11-20) repeats it: 'Four-wheel drive is recommended for anyone planning to camp here.' A standing agency 4WD recommendation for the whole campground, not limited to wet weather = skip (user_ekko_no_4wd; lead 15 Broken Arrow precedent).

name: Spread Creek Designated Camping Area
why: AWH 2026-11-20: skip. FS EDW road layer rates FR 30290 and spurs A-D maintenance level 2 'HIGH CLEARANCE VEHICLES' (as 497 Mower Tract); reviews: rougher past the first mile, 4WD suggested to sites 10-13. Moran Vista 6493 at the road's start (FS: 'Great area for large RVs') kept.

name: Fordville City Park
why: Known only from one AllStays listing (ID 47687, read 2026-11-21: '1st Ave, Fordville', 48.216353,-97.790184, tags 'primitive, playground', no site count, fee, season, phone or update date, no reviews; its only link is ndtourism.com, never a source). Nothing confirms that the city offers RV camping or that a 23-ft rig fits: not on the ND HHS statewide licensed RV park/campground list (Updated 07.17.2025, read 2026-11-21; its only Fordville licences are Fordville Dam, John D Hagen RV Park and Kirby's Kamping, while other Walsh County city parks with camping, e.g. Minto Park and Park River's East Meadow, are licensed); no City of Fordville web page found; gm.py for 'Fordville City Park' returns only the town centroid (no Google place); web searches find no Campendium, The Dyrt, FreeCampsites or city listing for it. Esri imagery 2026-11-21 (500 m frame, rendered) at the AllStays point: a town-block park south of the main street with a ball diamond, playground and picnic tables beside the rail yard and elevator; no pads, pedestals, camping area or parked RVs legible.

name: John D Hagen RV Park
why: Private park known only from the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025, via the 5975 verifier: 'JOHN D HAGEN RV PARK', 12851 58th St NE, Fordville, 9 lots) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: web searches for the name (full, short, with Fordville) and for the address return nothing; no Google Maps place (gm.py for the name, the short name and the address all resolve to 5975 Fordville Dam Recreation Area, 11 km SE); not on RV Life (Algolia: no ND 'hagen' hit; 20 km radius of the address returns only Fordville Dam and Homme Dam); not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 25 km); not on AllStays' Fordville page (lists only Fordville City Park, Fordville Dam, Majejcek Dam, R and J RV Park). Fails both the presence and the price indicator.

name: Hague Camping & Lodging
why: Private park on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025, re-fetched 2026-11-21: '153 HAGUE CAMPING & LODGING, 401 Main AVE, Hague ND 58542, Emmons', private individual licensee, inspected 4/17/2024, 9 lots) with no qualifying presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: its only site, hague-lodging-and-campgrounds.amp.pr, is site-builder template copy ('Claim your website' banner, stock photos, wrong county 'McLean County', 'learn about availability, rates', no rate, no site count, no hookups; gives 701-321-1276 and a gmail address); no Google Maps place (gm.py for the name returns Hague Motel in Hague NY, the address resolves to the bare street address 401 Main Ave W, the phone to nothing); not on RV Life (Algolia 25 km radius + 'hague' name query: only Hague City Park, Strasburg City Park, Camp 83 Herreid SD); not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 25 km); the only other listing is a Roadtrippers stub with placeholder amenity fields. The p3-458 verifier's judgement holds: fails both the presence (no working operator site with real content; no Google listing with 25+ reviews) and the price indicator.

name: Kirby's Kamping
why: Private park known only from the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025, via the 5975 verifier: 'KIRBY'S KAMPING', 205 Dakota St, Fordville, 10 lots) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: web searches for the name (alone, with Fordville, with Facebook) return nothing; no Google Maps place (gm.py for the name returns an unrelated Badger Creek Campground 190 km away); not on RV Life (Algolia, 15 km radius of the address returns only Fordville Dam; a 'Kirby' name query has no ND park); not on AllStays' or RoverPass's Fordville pages, Hipcamp or Campspot. Fails both the presence and the price indicator.

name: R and J RV Park
why: Private park known only from one AllStays directory listing (ID 41561: 120 Walsh St N, Fordville, 701-229-3351, May-Sep, 20/30/50 A + water, $$ = $12-20; no website, no reviews, no update date) with no live web presence, checked 2026-11-21: not on the ND HHS statewide licensed RV park/campground list (Updated 07.17.2025, every Fordville licence read: Fordville Dam, John D Hagen RV Park, Kirby's Kamping only); no Google Maps place (gm.py for 'R and J RV Park Fordville ND' and 'R&J RV Park' resolve to 5975 Fordville Dam; the address resolves to a bare street address with no business); not on RV Life (Algolia: 0 name hits, 20 km radius returns only Fordville Dam); not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 25 km); not on RoverPass's Fordville page; web searches for the name and for the phone number return only the AllStays page. Fails both the presence and the price indicator (an AllStays $$ is not an RV Life tier), and no current licence suggests it no longer operates.

name: Sheyenne RV Park
why: Private park known only from the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025, re-fetched 2026-11-21: '349 SHEYENNE RV PARK, 500 COTTON AVE, Sheyenne ND 58374, Eddy, licensee JOHNSON, RALPH ROGER, licensed 12/26/2024, 13' lots) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: web searches for the name (alone, with Sheyenne/58374, with Cotton Ave, with Facebook) return only Sheyenne Oaks (Leonard, Cass County, ~180 km SE) and Hendrickson Park; Google Maps (gm.py) for the name, the address and 'RV park Sheyenne ND' resolves to Sheyenne Oaks Campground in Leonard or to the bare town, no place at the address; RV Life (Algolia, 30 km radius + 'sheyenne' name query) has only Hendrickson Park, Warsing Dam, Schuster (New Rockford), Spirit Lake Casino and Graham's Island; not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 15 km). Fails both the presence and the price indicator.

name: Viking Campground
why: Private park (ND HHS licensed list 07.17.2025: 'EVANS CAMPGROUND', 129 3rd St SW, Mayville, licence held by an individual, 8 lots, licensed 6/1/2022) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: no operator website, booking page, Hipcamp/Campspot/RoverPass listing or Facebook found; Google Maps 'Viking Campground' (47.49702,-97.32761, the HHS address) shows no phone, no website and no reviews; not on RV Life (Algolia, 5 km radius returns only 5971 Willowood); the only listing anywhere is ndtourism.com, never a source. Fails both the presence and the price indicator, and as a park the lone listing tags for monthly/seasonal rentals it would also need a posted nightly rate or booking site (long-stay test 2).

name: Warsing Dam Campground
kind_of_no: AWH-dropped entry 6013 (same place); camping is a WMA allowance with no designated sites
why: This lead is the former DB entry 6013 Warsing Dam Campground (pin 47.83430,-99.10950, ~0.5 km from the lead's RV Life point), dropped by AWH 2026-11-12 ('Drop Warsing Dam'; audit/verify/removals.json). Re-checked 2026-11-21: no official source designates campsites. ND Game and Fish lists Warsing Dam as an 86-acre WMA, '1 mile northeast of Sheyenne. Overnight camping prohibited Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except holidays' (gf.nd.gov/wma-listing, and gf.nd.gov/wma's Thursday-Monday list), which is the general WMA camping allowance. G&F's Fishing Facilities layer (ndgishub GNF_FishingWaters layer 4) lists only a vault toilet, a T-shaped floating pier, a concrete ramp, a dock and a spillway, with no campsites, and names Eddy County Park Board as owner of the pier, ramp and dock. Not on the ND HHS licensed RV park/campground list (07.17.2025; Eddy County rows are New Rockford and Sheyenne RV Park only). No Eddy County web page exists. The only site counts are directories (AllStays 5 sites, tables and toilets, tents; ndtourism is never a source). Esri imagery shows two gravel loops among trees with picnic shelters and a vault toilet, and no pads or parked RVs. Under the wildlife-agency rule, an allowance with no agency designation is out.

name: The English Pale Campground and Resort
why: AWH 2026-11-21: skip. Passed every gate (5 rustic RV sites, $35.30, Hipcamp + own site, Google 5.0/25), but guests must be 21+ and nudity is tolerated at the sites, beach and sundeck.

name: Happy Campers Campground
why: Mostly seasonal park that fails long-stay test 4 and the Google screen. On Campspot (park 6132, read 2026-11-22), only 14 of the map's 156 RV pads are sold by the night, about 9% and under 1 in 10. Seven of those are 'Exclusive' sites bookable only within 15 days. The operator site stayhappycampers.com (read 2026-11-22 in a headless browser after Cloudflare refused curl) calls it 'a seasonal campground' and sells sites through a '2027 Camp Agreement', with deck and firepit permits. Google rates it 3.7 from 64 reviews (gm.py, 2026-11-22), under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. The price only just meets the gate: $50.00 for a 30A full-hookup weeknight plus a $3 per-stay campground fee, with no gateway within 40 km.

name: Gross Hill Campground at Lake Byron
kind_of_no: price + presence (private, no rate and no live presence anywhere)
why: Private campground beside the Gross Hill Barn bar/antique store at 40426 North Shore Road, Lake Byron. Its only listings are the city's camping page (huronsd.gov/172/Camping, read 2026-11-22: '46 camping sites with full hookups: water, sewer, 50 amp electrical. For reservations, call 605-350-2050') and a tourism-association member directory (sdglaciallakes.com/directory/gross-hill-lake-byron, read 2026-11-22: '26 full service hook-ups available'). Neither posts a rate; there is no website (grosshill.com is an unrelated domain now parked for sale at HugeDomains), no booking engine, no RV Life record (Algolia name and Lake Byron bounding-box queries both return 0, 2026-11-22), and the only Google place is 'Gross Hill Barn' categorised Bar, 4.7/30, unclaimed, no phone and no website, newest visible reviews 7-8 years old (gm 2026-11-22). Fails both private indicators (price and presence), the 5842 precedent.

name: Red Wilk Campground
kind_of_no: presence + price (private, no web presence or rate)
why: Private campground run from Red Wilk Construction's yard (1562 Old Hwy 14 W, Huron; phone 605-352-0735 is the construction company's). Its only description is a third-party paragraph on the City of Huron camping page (https://huronsd.gov/172/Camping, read 2026-11-22: '46 camping spots on hard ground surfaces. All are 30 or 50 amp ... Call Red Wilk at 605-352-0735 for information and reservations'), which posts no rate. No operator website, no booking engine, no RV Life listing (Algolia query + Huron bbox 2026-11-22: only Memorial Park and the State Fairgrounds), not in the Good Sam directory cache; Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-22) has only 'Red Wilk Construction' at that address, 4.5 on 4 reviews, no website. Fails both private indicators (price and presence), like the 5842 Outback precedent.

name: Izaak Walton League Madison Chapter #16 (clubhouse camping)
kind_of_no: not shown to sell public nights; club grounds with no laid-out campground
why: The Madison chapter's own camping text (madisonizaakwalton.com/about-us/clubhouse-rental-camping; live site refuses TLS from here, read in Wayback 2025-07-16 and 2026-03-17) only says 'Bring your family and friends for a private retreat. We have 30 AMP electrical hook ups available to rent during the summer months, for information contact [a club officer] @ 605.270.4415. Nightly Camping Rate $20.00 with electricity / $15.00 without electricity' - no site count, and unlike the clubhouse rental on the same page ('by members and non-members') it never says non-members may camp, while the Become a Member page (Wayback 2025-07-16) lists camping among what membership ($70/$100) gives. The grounds are the club's shotgun range ('located next to the Clubhouse, which is West of Prairie Village on Lake Herman'; leagues Monday and Tuesday nights, 'available for private use to members'), and Esri imagery 2026-11-22 at the Google pin shows a small clubhouse in trees plus open mown grass on the north shore of Lake Herman - no pads, rows or hookup posts. Not a publicly-bookable campground on the evidence available; a phone call is the only route to settle it (not attempted).

name: Lakeshore Golf and RV Park (= Lakes RV Resort)
kind_of_no: same place as lead 8 (Lakes RV Resort, Wentworth): seasonal-lease RV community that sells lots
why: rvpark.com's 'Lakeshore Golf & RV Resort' carries the same address (100 Silver Creek Dr, Wentworth) and phone ((605) 483-3800) as Lakes RV Resort, vetted and skipped as lead 8 (lakeside-rv-lake-madison) 2026-11-22: seasonal leases only, lots for sale, no nightly price, no presence of its own.

name: Lakes RV Resort (lead name 'Lakeside RV Resort')
kind_of_no: seasonal-lease RV community that sells lots; no nightly sale, no price, no presence of its own
why: No park named 'Lakeside RV Resort' exists at Lake Madison on Google Maps, RV Life (Algolia bbox 43.85..44.15 N, -97.25..-96.85, 2026-11-22), the Good Sam directory cache or the web; the only RV resort on the lake is Lakes RV Resort, 100 Silver Creek Dr/Trl, Wentworth (Google 'Lakes RV Resort' 4.6/30, RV park, (605) 483-3800, read 2026-11-22; rvpark.com lists it as 'Lakeshore Golf & RV Resort', same phone). Its own pages (golfatthelakes.com, Wayback 2019-05-15) call it a 'seasonal RV community' offering 'Seasonal RV Sites Available for Rent' and post only 'Seasonal Lease Rates ... (April 15th to Oct 15th) $2,500.00 or $2,700.00 depending on location of site'; the lease (BPS LLC dba Lakes RV Resort, Wayback 2017-01-08) is a 6-month term, and the site's RV Resort menu was 'Lots for Sale', with a 'South_Park_Sites_1-51_Map_with_Revisions_SOLD' site map; a 2025 MLS listing (#22500609, Century 21 / LandMark Realty, page now 404) offered unit 110 at 100 Silver Creek Trl, 0.08 acre, $63,000, in 'Lake Madison RV Resort'. The overnight rates it posted in 2012 ($30-49.50, 2-night weekend minimum) were gone by 2019. Today's golfatthelakes.com (read 2026-11-22) is the golf course only and never mentions the RV resort. Fails long-stay tests 2 (no nightly rate or booking), 3 (seasonal lease) and 5 (sells lots), and the private presence rule.

name: Camp America Campground
why: Camp America is the former name of Dakota Sunsets Campground (15751, added from lead 3). Both are at 25495 US Highway 81, Salem SD 57058. RoverPass's unclaimed 'Camp America Campground' listing (read 2026-11-22) gives that address and the old phone (605) 425-9085, with its point 43.68889,-97.38995, 29 m from 15751's pin. The Dyrt's page at the slug /camping/south-dakota/camp-america-campground (read 2026-11-22) now titles it 'Dakota Sunsets RV Park' at 25495 US Highway 81, with its point 109 m from the pin. Good Sam's directory URL slug camp-america-campground-300004625 also carries the Dakota Sunsets listing (seen in search results; goodsam.com refuses automated reads). The DB holds no other entry within 2 km and no other entry named Camp America.

name: IceRock Campground
kind_of_no: mostly seasonal, no posted nightly rate or booking site (long-stay test 2)
why: Operator site icerockcampground.com (live, read 2026-11-22) calls it 'A Seasonal Campground'; its Sites page says 'Most of our campsites are reserved for seasonal campers, but we occasionally have openings for weekend, weekly, or nightly stays. Availability can vary, so give us a call to check for current openings', and sells seasonal sites with winter camper storage ('Add a deck ... your home away from home'). No rate of any kind on any page (sitemap's 10 pages read) and no booking engine: 'Call 605-261-5312 for availability'. A mostly-seasonal private park needs a posted nightly rate or a booking site that sells one night (curation doc long-stay test 2; an RV Life tier or camper report cannot stand in), so it fails.

name: Rooster's RV Park
why: Private park with no presence and no price anywhere (2026-11-22): Google Maps 'Rooster's RV Park', Campground, 419 Striker Drive, Clear Lake SD 57226 (44.7550226,-96.6719839) is unclaimed with no phone, website, photos or reviews; not on RV Life (Algolia park index, query 'rooster' and a 44.6-44.9 / -96.9 to -96.45 box: none), not in the Good Sam directory cache, not on Hipcamp's Clear Lake SD page, no hit on clearlakesd.com (site search 'rooster', 'striker'), and web searches for the name and street found nothing. Esri imagery shows a real-looking gravel RV lot (two rows of ~16 angled pull-through pads, a few RVs) ~200 m NNE of the Google pin, so it exists, but it fails the private presence and price tests (cf. 5842 Outback precedent).

name: S & J Campground & RV Park
why: Private park with no presence and no price anywhere (2026-11-22). Its only web mention is the Miller C&C / City of Miller 'Places to Stay' page (millersd.org/places-to-stay/, read 2026-11-22): 'S & J Campground & RV Park (Right next to Willie's Bar & Grill) St. Lawrence, SD 57373 (605) 204-0642 (605) 853-0642 State Inspected Campground' plus a personal Yahoo email. That page gives no rate, site count, hookups or season. It has no Google Maps listing: gm.py queries 'S & J Campground St. Lawrence SD', 'S&J RV Park Saint Lawrence South Dakota' and 'S and J Campground St Lawrence SD 57373' returned Rafter J (Hill City) or the town itself. It is not on RV Life (Algolia park index, 44.3-44.75 / -99.3 to -98.6 box: only Crystal Park and Lake Louise; name queries 'S&J', 'S & J', 'S and J': no SD hit) and not in the Good Sam directory cache. Willie's own site (williesbarandgrillsd.com home/about/contact) does not mention camping or RVs. Web searches for the name and both phone numbers found nothing else. It fails the private presence and price tests (cf. 5842 Outback and the Rooster's RV Park lead).

name: Gnat Campground
why: Private campsites with no price and no presence anywhere (read 2026-11-22): the only source is one listing on the On Hand Development Corporation's Places to Stay page (millersd.org/places-to-stay/, modified 2025-12-19: 'Gnat Campground West of Farm Tech 1301 W. 1st Ave., Miller ... & also located north of the nursing home 420 E. 6th St.', call an individual's cell 605-870-3613), with no rate, site count, hookups or season; no website, booking engine, Google Maps place, RV Life listing or camper review exists -> fails the private price + presence test (precedent 5842).

name: Lakeview Motel & Campground
why: Private motel with RV sites but no RV price anywhere (read 2026-11-22): its own Wix site (lakeviewmotelandcampground.com: Home/Amenities/Rooms/Contact) lists only 'Free WiFi / Campground Shower Facilities' with no RV sites, rates or count; the town lodging page (pollocksouthdakota.org/lodging) describes motel rooms and 'campground shower facilities' only; its WebRez engine (secure.webrez.com/property/3145) offers motel-room filters only and stops at a Cloudflare 'Verifying you are human' check (not bypassed); no RV Life listing (Algolia, 15 km: only West Pollock SRA x2 and Lake Pocasse) -> no price indicator for an RV night (precedent 5842).

name: Pollock RV Park
why: Private RV park with no nightly price and no live presence (read 2026-11-22): no website or booking engine of its own; Google Maps (gm.py, 2026-11-22) 'Pollock RV Park', 1021 O Street Box 207, Pollock, 605-889-2512, 4.7 stars / 3 reviews, no website - under 25 reviews, so not a presence indicator; no RV Life listing (RV Life Pollock region shows only West Pollock SRA and Lake Pocasse, as the sister lead's Algolia check within 15 km found); the current town lodging page (pollocksouthdakota.org/lodging) no longer lists it, and Wayback holds no capture of it since 2024. The only rate wording known (the lead's 2023 town page: '3 Day, Weekly, Monthly, & Full Season Rates - Winter Parking') offers no single night - fails long-stay tests 2/3 even if it were current (precedent 5842).

name: T-Bone's Dog Ear Lake camping spots
kind_of_no: no nightly sale / no price (private, 2 phone-only spots)
why: tbonestreehouse.com/rentals-1 (read 2026-11-22, 2026 copyright): the only mention is under 'Other Rentals' beside the $675/month Winner spots and monthly storage units - 'We have 2 camping spots overlooking the beautiful Dog Ear Lake 17 miles south of Winner. Includes water, sewer, & power hookups. Call (605) 840-9571 for details.' No rate, no nightly sale, no booking engine, no pad size; the Rates page lists only hunts and 'Lodging $70/person'. Fails the private price indicator and long-stay test 2 (nights really for sale); 2 spots is not a campground.

name: Cedar Shore Campground
why: Private resort campground with no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py) and not a Good Sam Park; the operator posts no nightly rate and its booking engine had no inventory for any 2027 date (read 2026-11-22), but every 2026 camper report is over US$50 even in September and October ($60, $60, $60, $64, $79 for full-hookup sites, RV Life reviews dated Aug-Oct 2026), and the resort FAQ adds an 8% resort fee to each reservation; RV Life rates it $$$.

name: Oasis Campground
why: Private park (now 'Oasis Campground', formerly Al's Oasis Campground) whose cheapest electric RV night is US$65.95 on its own CampWorks booking engine for 2027 shoulder dates (Wed 2027-04-07 and Wed 2027-05-12, site 1 Full Hookup Standard back-in 40 ft, 23-ft motorhome, 2 adults, read 2026-11-22); it is a Good Sam Park, but the engine's Good Sam discount takes only $7.18 off (~$59 before tax, plus a $5.44 online booking fee), still over US$50, and gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Badlands NP 205 km).
